title: rusolve.event/1
description: One line of the NDJSON progress stream `rusolve mip --log-format jsonl` writes on stderr. Written by crates/rusolve-cli/src/progress.rs from the ported HiGHS callbacks kCallbackMipImprovingSolution and kCallbackMipInterrupt. Every line is one JSON object; the HiGHS text log is not written in this mode. The last line is always a `final` event whose status, objective, dual_bound and gap equal the `--format json` envelope (rusolve-result-1) of the same run. Non-finite solver values (an infinite bound before the first incumbent) are null.

event.description: phase: the solve entered a phase. incumbent: an improving solution was found. bound: the dual bound moved (at most one per 50 ms). watchdog: the wall-clock watchdog acted. final: the last line.

t.description: Seconds since the solve started (after the model was read).

phase.description: HiGHS has no phase callback: `presolve` is announced before Highs::run, `root` at the first MIP interrupt callback (presolve is done, the root node is being evaluated), `tree` when a callback first reports a positive node count.

objective.description: Objective of the new incumbent in the original model's sense and offset.

source.description: HiGHS solution source name (HighsMipSolverData::solutionSourceToString), e.g. `Feasibility jump`, `Sub-MIP`, `Branching`; null when HiGHS did not report one.

source_code.description: The one-letter code of that source in the HiGHS log.

gap.description: Relative gap as a fraction; null without a finite gap.

improvement.description: 1 for the first incumbent, 2 for the next, ...

action.description: interrupt_requested: the limit was reached and the interrupt callback was asked to stop the solve. hard_stop: the solve did not return within the grace period; the watchdog prints the result from the last state the callbacks saw and ends the process with exit code 0.

limit.description: The envelope's `limit` object (kind, enforced_by, improving); null when no limit ended the solve.
